semantic_contract.purpose: Resolve one Cell damage interaction: reject disallowed attacks, calculate damage, update victim health and nearby reactions, emit a damage animation/effect, and route lethal damage to the appropriate death path.
preconditions: victim->field_17C is zero and victim->mIsInvulnerable is false.
Victim and attacker pool/resource context is valid; no explicit null check is present.
postconditions: Accepted damage subtracts GetDamageAmount(attacker, victim) from victim->mHealthPoints.
mHealthPoints is clamped to zero and never becomes negative.
A health rollover is requested when victim or attacker is avatar-related or attacker->field_110 is true.
If health reaches zero, the selected player/non-player death path is called and its result is returned.
If health remains positive, a damage animation/effect path is dispatched and the function returns 1.
Rejected damage returns 0 without the accepted health write.
